name: Medieval War Simulator
desc:
Defend your base against your enemies! Upgrade, Attack, and Defend with your army! The game is difficult to beat. It is highly recommended to play it with your friends! 

If you have any feedbacks, suggestions or found bugs, then please feel free to comment it in our group!
